## 1. Scheme Information

*Id*:
44

*Scheme Code*:
ndksp-organic-production-unit

*Sponsor*:
State

*Scheme Provider*:
Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp

*Scheme Name*:
Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp

*Main Component*:
Organic Production Unit

*Sub Component*:
1. Vermicompost Production Unit 
2. NADEP Compost Production Unit

*Introduction*:
Under the organic farming system, conserving nature, reducing crop production costs, and increasing the use of alternative organic and biological inputs for hazardous chemicals like chemical fertilizers, pesticides, herbicides, and hormones is the need of the hour. Vermicompost is made from farm waste, plant-based materials, and cow dung by earthworms. Vermicompost contains various bacteria, enzymes, vitamins, and other useful chemicals, which have a positive effect on plant growth. 
Similarly, processing farm waste through composting results in the decomposition of its organic matter through biological methods by microorganisms and earthworms, producing excellent humus-like organic compost. If this compost is used extensively in the fields, it will significantly improve soil health and greatly boost agricultural production. It is the need of the hour to prepare organic manure from all plant-based materials generated in the field and return it to the field. Organic manure improves soil texture and water retention capacity, ensuring an adequate supply of nutrients. The soil remains friable, which keeps it aerated. It helps in the growth of beneficial microorganisms in the farm. 
In this regard, considering the above matter, it is proposed to implement the Vermicompost Production Unit and NADEP Compost Production Unit as individual benefit components.

*Benefits*:
1.To enable small and marginal farmers in the village clusters included in the Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp to adapt to the situation arising from climate change.
2. To produce nutritious food grains.
3. To practice agriculture by making proper use of natural elements without harming them.
4. To increase soil fertility and maintain it for a long time.
5. To reuse local resources in agriculture.
6. To reduce the cost of agricultural production and increase the net income of the farmer.

*Eligibility*:
1. Farmers who have received benefits from any other scheme for this component will not receive benefits again under this scheme.
2. After the unit is established, the benefit will be given to farmers who have at least two large livestock (cows, buffaloes, or bullocks) available to ensure its proper functioning.
3. The benefits of this component under the project will be available to beneficiaries who own up to 5.00 hectares of land.

*Required Documents*:
1. If the applicant is a person with disability, a disability certificate should be provided.
2. If the applicant belongs to the Scheduled Castes or Scheduled Tribes category, evidence related to that.
3. If the applicant is a joint account holder, a consent letter from the other account holders shall be submitted.

*Application Process*:
The NDKSP DBT Portal has been created with the following objectives - 
DBT System for accepting and processing subsidy applications received from farmers. Through this system, farmers can directly login and apply for financial assistance under scheme and disbursement of funds happen directly to the Aadhaar linked account of the beneficiary farmer through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mode. There is no need for farmer to visit a government office to apply for subsidy or receive disbursed funds. Also, farmers can track and monitor their applications in real time which shows transparency in NDKSP operations. This system facilitates NDKSP to perform its approval process in 100% paperless manner which eliminates intermediaries and establishes credibility. 
To avail the benefits of the components under the project, the beneficiary (farmer) must directly login on the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system using their Farmer ID. After login, the beneficiary becomes eligible to receive the project benefits. Additionally, it is mandatory for the beneficiary to link their Aadhaar number with their bank account so that the benefit amount can be directly transferred to their personal bank account.
The following farmer attributes need to be entered in the Portal: 
Farmer Attributes: (Essential): 
State, District, Sub-District/Block, Village, Farmer Name, Type of Identity  Farmer ID for landholder farmer is essential, Gender, Category, land cosent letter for joint landholders. 
Farmer Login and application Module:
Step 1: Farmer Login and Application Process through the "Mahavistaar-AI Application"
a) First, download and install the "Mahavistaar-AI Application" from the "Google Play Store" on your mobile.
b) After entering the application, enter your registered Farmer ID.
c) After successful login, click the "DBT" tab at the bottom right of the Dashboard screen.
d) Upon clicking, click the "NDKSP (PoCRA)" tab.
e) To avail benefits for various items under individual components, click the "Click Here" link at the end of this screen to apply.
f) Following this, your NDKSP (PoCRA) project dashboard screen will be available.
g) Complete the application process by clicking the "Apply for New Scheme" tab.
Step 2: Farmer Login and application Process through the "Project's DBT Web Portal"
a) Visit to "https://mahapocra.gov.in/mr/applications" NDKSP 2.0 website
b) After entering the webpage of Farmer login, enter your registered Farmer ID.
c) After successful login, dashboard screen will be available.
d) Complete the application process by clicking the "Apply for New Scheme" tab.

*Source Url*:
https://mahapocra.gov.in/documents/Vermicompost_and_NADEP_Compost_Production_Unit_Guidelines.pdf

This scheme is eligible for PoCRA villages only.

## 2. Scheme Information

*Id*:

mahadbt-baksy

*Sponsor*:

*Scheme Name*:
Dr Babasaheb Ambedkar Krushi Swavalamban Yojana (BAKSY)

*Main Component*:
Providing Irrigation Fscilities to the eligible beneficiaries of Scheduled Cast (SC) category

*Sub Component*:
1. New Irrigation Well
2. Old Well Repair
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds
4. Inwell Boring

6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)
7. Solar pump (instead of electrical connection Charges and pump set)

9. Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) AND
     Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements)
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden

*Introduction*:
The Scheduled Caste Sub-Plan (Special Component Scheme(scp)) was being implemented from the year 1982-83 to increase the income of Scheduled Caste / New-Buddhist farmers and improve their standard of living. Since the said scheme has been implemented for a long period of time, the GOVERNMENT OF MAHARASHTRA has decided to implement the Special Component Scheme for Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist farmers since 1982-83 and the recommendations of the Agriculture Commissionerate dated 27/04/2016 on the report dated 19/04/2016 and special component scheme the announced by the Hon'ble Minister (Finance). Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana is not being implemented separately, but the current special component scheme, Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana, is being implemented from 2016-17 as per the changed criteria, taking into account the needs of the changed situation and maintaining soil moisture.
Also, the government has approved the amendment in the financial criteria and inclusion of new components under the said scheme as per the government decision dated 01 October, 2024.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    beneficiary Selection criteria are as follows
1.  Scheme is only for Scheduled Caste/ Nav Baudha farmers.
2.  Scheme is implemented in all districts of Maharashtra (Except Mumbai districts).
3. At field level  scheme is under Implementation by department of Agriculture, Zilha Parishad.
4. Funds are released from Social Justice Department to concerned  District Collector and then made available to concern Zilha Parishad.
5. Application ,Selection of beneficiaries upto payment of subsidy all process are done through MAHADBT Portal through online system.                                                                  "

*Benefits*:
Benefit provided on subsidy basis as per the norms of components, through online system. The said scheme shall be implemented in the financial year 2025-26 as follows. In the said scheme, grants shall be admissible for the following components in the year 2025-26 up to the maximum limit of the amount mentioned below.
1. For New Irrigation- Well Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Rs.4,00,000/ - is admissible.
2. For Old Well Repair - Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 1,00,000/- is admissible
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds-Grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the amount calculated as per the prevailing financial parameters of the National Horticulture Mission Guideline and the size of the farm pond or actual cost or Rs. 2,00,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
4.Inwell Boring- Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 40,000/- is admissible
5. Electricity Connection-Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Amount 20,000/- or actual paid amount whichever is less is admissible.
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)(Diesel Engine - New Item) For pump sets up to 10 HP capacity, grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial parameters or actual cost or Rs. 40,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
7. Grant Solar pump (instead of electrical connection and pump set)- Maximum subsidy will be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial criteria or actual expenditure incurred or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)- Under the Food and Nutrition Security Scheme - Food Crops Scheme, subsidy of 100% of the prevailing economic standard or actual cost incurred per meter or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less will be admissible.
9.1 For Micro irrigation system Under Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) 9.1.1) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and9.1.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 47,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy. (Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
9.2 For Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant 9.2.1 ) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and 9.2.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 97,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy.(Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements) (New item)maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden (New Item) maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible .

*Eligibility*:
1. Scheme is only for Scheduled Tribe farmers. Caste  certificate is essential.
2. Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to  6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential)
3.1 It will be mandatory for the beneficiary to be a farmer belonging to the Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist category.
3.2 The farmer must have a caste certificate issued by the competent authority.
3.3 Farmers residing the Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika is necessary to have 7/12 certificate and 8A extract of land tenure in the name of the farmer. ( Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika area (Reference Government Letter No. Sankirna- 2017/Pr.No.142/3A, dated 24 April 2018))
3.4 The beneficiaries must have their own Aadhaar link active bank account .
3.5 The beneficiaries below the poverty line will be given  first priority.
3.6 The beneficiary farmer must have a minimum of 0.40 hectares and a maximum of 6 hectares of agricultural land. If the beneficiary's land is in a remote and fragmented area and two or more beneficiaries with less than 0.40 hectares of land come together and their combined land is at least 0.40 hectares, then if they sign an agreement, they will be eligible for the benefit of the scheme. Similarly, the condition of maximum 6.0 hectares of land will not be applicable to the beneficiaries below the poverty line.
3.7 Once the full benefit of the relevant scheme is taken, the benefit of this scheme will not be payable to the same beneficiary or family for the next five years. The beneficiary who has taken the benefit of the new well component will be eligible for the benefit of the old well repair component after 20 years.
If the benefit has been given under the Special Component Scheme for similar agricultural development schemes and the scheme implemented from the funds made available under the SCA of the Central Government and Article 275 (A) of the Constitution, the benefit provided under this scheme will not be admissible.

*Required Documents*:
1. Caste Certificate of SC category issued by compitant authority
2. current 7/12 report having Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to 6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential) within the period of
3 months 3.GSDA Certificates
4. There is no income limit for this scheme

*Application Process*:
Application is to done online on Mahadbt portal as follows
1. Applications from farmers are being invited for the said scheme on the Maha-DBT portal website mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/farmer/login /login and the applications received within the limit of lakhs received by the concerned talukas / blocks will be selected online on a first come, first served basis (fcfs). After selection, all the proceedings up to the payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done online. In this regard, proceedings from acceptance of application to payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done as mentioned in the referenced government decision dated 04/11/2020.
2. The Agricultural Officer (Agriculture), P.S., should conduct a site inspection of the area of the beneficiary selected for the new well and old well repair on a first come, first served basis and check the technical feasibility. After the inspection, if the location of the beneficiary's new well and the proposal for repair of the old well of the beneficiary is technically suitable, the Agricultural Development Officer should approve the budget for this matter and give prior approval to the proposals of the concerned beneficiary within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents. Similarly, the selection of the beneficiaries whose proposals are found to be technically unsuitable during the site inspection should be cancelled.
3. Beneficiaries selected for other matters other than new well and old well repair under the scheme should be given prior approval within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents and they should be given the benefit of the scheme in the current financial year 2025-26 itself.
4. The prior approval of the beneficiaries who do not implement the matters under the scheme within the prescribed period should be cancelled.
5. While selecting individual beneficiary, priority will be given to women and disabled beneficiaries. Out of the total sanctioned funds, 5 percent of the funds should be given priority to be spent on disabled beneficiaries and 30 percent of the funds should be spent on women beneficiaries.
6. As per the demand of the final selected beneficiaries as per the target of the taluka & district, a draft plan of the district should be prepared within 7 days as per Appendix No. 1, component-wise and beneficiary-wise. The responsibility of preparing the draft plan will be the responsibility of the Agricultural Development Officer.

Individual Beneficiary

Individual Beneficiary (New)

*Introduction*:
1. Introduction
 Ministry of Food Processing Industries (MoFPI) launched Prime Minister Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME) Scheme from 2020-21 to 2024-25 for unorganized sector of food processing. The expenditure under the scheme would be shared in 60:40 ratio between Central and State Governments.

 2. Objectives
 a. Enhance the competitiveness of existing individual micro-enterprises in the unorganized segment of the food processing industry and promote formalization of the sector
 b. Support Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs), Self Help Groups (SHGs) and Producers Cooperatives along their entire value chain.
 c. Increased access to credit by existing micro food processing entrepreneurs, FPOs, Self Help Groups and Co-operatives.
 d. Integration with organized supply chain by strengthening branding & marketing.
 e. Support for transition of existing enterprises into formal framework.
 f. Increased access to common services like common processing facility, laboratories, storage, packaging, marketing and incubation services.
 g. Strengthening of institutions, research and training in the food processing sector.
 h. Increased access for the enterprises to professional and technical support.

*Benefits*:
Credit-linked capital subsidy @35% of the eligible project cost with a maximum ceiling of Rs.10.0 lakh per unit

*Eligibility*:
o Individual Entrepreneurs/ Proprietorship Firms, Partnership Firms, NGO, Pvt. Ltd. Company are eligible.
 o Both New and Existing Enterprises are eligible.
 o Individual Applicant age should be above 18 years.
 o No minimum education qualification is required.
 o Eligible project cost comprises of cost of Plant & Machinery and Technical Civil Work.
 o Cost of Technical Civil Work should not be more than 30% of Eligible Project cost.
 o Beneficiary contribution should be minimum 10% of eligible project cost.
 o Project cost with balance required fund being loan from bank.
 o Cost of land/rental or lease work shed should not be part of project cost.
 o No prior experience is required.

*Required Documents*:
For New Enterprises :
 A) Mandatory Documents
 1. PAN Card of concern/all promoters
 2. Aadhaar Copy & Photo of all promoters/guarantors
 3. Address Proof:
 I. Utility bill, which is not more than two months old of any service
 provider, (Electricity, telephone, post-paid mobile phone, piped gas, water bill) or
 ii. Property or Municipal tax paid receipt or
 iii. Ration Card (Individual)
 4. Photocopy of Bank Statement/ Bank Passbook for the last 6 months

 B) Optional Documents
 1. Photocopy of highest academic qualification of promoter/s
 2. Sanction letter of active loans,
 3. Loan statement of active loans
 4. Any other Document

*Application Process*:
Visit the PMFME portal Link: PMFME Registration : https://pmfme.mofpi.gov.in/pmfme/#/Register-New-User.

 Step 1: Visit the Official Portal
 - Go to the official PMFME website: [https://pmfme.mofpi.gov.in](https://pmfme.mofpi.gov.in).

  Step 2: Registration Process
 1. Click on Login and select New Registration.
 2. Choose your applicant type: Individual, Group or Common Infrastructure.
 3. Fill in basic details:
  - Name, mobile number, email ID
  - Aadhaar number
  - State and district
 4. After filling basic details, login credentials are sent by email and mobile no.
 5. Verify your mobile number via OTP.
 6. Set your password.
 6. Submit the registration form and log in using your credentials.

  Step 3: Filling the Online Application
 1. After login, click on Apply for PMFME Scheme.
 2. Complete the application form with the following sections:
  - Personal Information: Name, gender, age, contact details
  - Business Details: Type of enterprise, location, nature of food processing activity
  - Financial Details: Estimated project cost, proposed loan amount, bank details
  - Infrastructure & Machinery: Existing setup and proposed upgrades
  - Training & Capacity Building Needs
 3. Upload required documents:
  - Aadhaar card
  - Passport-size photo
  - Business registration certificate (if applicable)

  - Project report
  - Quotations for machinery
 4. Review all entries carefully before submission.

  Step 5: Final Submission
 - Click Submit to complete the application.
 - Youll receive an Application ID for tracking.
 - Save or print the acknowledgment for future reference.

  Step 6: Follow-Up and Support
 - Track your application status via the portal.
 - For assistance, contact the helpline: +91-9254997101 / +91-9254997102.

question: लहान शेतकऱ्यांसाठी कोणत्या योजनांमध्ये अनुदान जास्त मिळते?
answer:
आपल्या प्रोफाईलनुसार, आपण एक लहान शेतकरी आहात (1.81 हेक्टर जमीन), अगदी योग्य आहे लहान शेतकऱ्यांसाठी जास्त अनुदान देणाऱ्या काही प्रमुख शासकीय योजना खालीलप्रमाणे:

1. **डॉ. बाबासाहेब आंबेडकर कृषी स्वावलंबन योजना (BAKSY)**  
ही योजना अनुसूचित जाती (SC) कॅटेगरीसाठी आहे. यात जलसिंचन सुविधा, नवीन विहीर, पंपसेट, प्लास्टिक लाईनिंग आणि शेती यंत्रसामग्रींवर उच्च प्रमाणात अनुदान मिळते. उदाहरणार्थ, नवीन विहिरीसाठी रु.4,00,000 पर्यंत, पंपसेटसाठी रु.40,000 पर्यंत अनुदान दिले जाते.

2. **नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्प अंतर्गत ड्रिप सिंचन व स्प्रिंकलर सिंचन योजना**  
ही योजना पोकऱ्यासाठी आहे आणि आधुनिक सिंचन प्रणालीस प्रोत्साहन देते. लहानशेती मालकांसाठी सिंचन सिस्टीमसाठी ५ हेक्टरपर्यंत जमीन असलेल्या शेतकऱ्यांना अधिक अनुदान दिले जाते.

3. **मुख्यमंत्री सतत शेती सिंचन योजना - वैयक्तिक फार्म पोंड**  
शेतकऱ्यांना त्यांच्या जमिनीवर जलसाठा ठेवण्यासाठी वैयक्तिक फार्म पोंडसाठी ₹14,433 ते ₹75,000 पर्यंत अनुदान मिळते. यासाठी किमान जमिनीचा अंश ठरवलेला आहे (कोंकणात 0.20 हा, इतर भागात 0.40 हा).

4. **नमो शेतकरी महासन्मान निधी (NSMNY)**  
PM-KISAN लाभार्थींसाठी अतिरिक्त ₹6,000 प्रति वर्ष देय असलेली ही योजना आहे, ज्यासाठी काही अतिरिक्त अर्ज करावयाची गरज नाही.

आपल्या जमिनीची एकूण क्षेत्रफळ 1.81 हेक्टर असल्याने, आपण या योजनांमध्ये पात्र असण्याची शक्यता आहे, विशेषतः मुख्यमंत्री सतत शेती सिंचन योजना आणि नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्पातील सिंचन योजनांसाठी.  

आपल्या जातीचा वर्ग 'सामान्य' असल्यामुळे बाबासाहेब आंबेडकर योजना थेट लागू होत नाही.

**कृपया लक्षात ठेवा:** नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्पातील ड्रिप व स्प्रिंकलर सिंचन योजना आणि सुधारित योजना पोरका गावांसाठी (PoCRA villages) लागू आहेत. आपल्या गावाची तपासणी करून यासाठी योग्य होय की नाही ते स्थानिक कृषी अधिकारी कोणत्याही शंका असल्यास विचारावे.

तुम्हाला कुठल्या विशिष्ट योजने बाबत अधिक माहिती पाहिजे का? किंवा अर्ज कसा करायचा याची मदत हवी आहे का?

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

## 1. Scheme Information

*Id*:
65

*Scheme Code*:
mahadbt-baksy

*Sponsor*:
State

*Scheme Provider*:
Maha-DBT

*Scheme Name*:
Dr Babasaheb Ambedkar Krushi Swavalamban Yojana (BAKSY)

*Main Component*:
Providing Irrigation Fscilities to the eligible beneficiaries of Scheduled Cast (SC) category

*Sub Component*:
1. New Irrigation Well
2. Old Well Repair
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds
4. Inwell Boring
5. Electricity Connection
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)
7. Solar pump (instead of electrical connection Charges and pump set)
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)
9. Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) AND
     Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements)
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden

*Introduction*:
The Scheduled Caste Sub-Plan (Special Component Scheme(scp)) was being implemented from the year 1982-83 to increase the income of Scheduled Caste / New-Buddhist farmers and improve their standard of living. Since the said scheme has been implemented for a long period of time, the GOVERNMENT OF MAHARASHTRA has decided to implement the Special Component Scheme for Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist farmers since 1982-83 and the recommendations of the Agriculture Commissionerate dated 27/04/2016 on the report dated 19/04/2016 and special component scheme the announced by the Hon'ble Minister (Finance). Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana is not being implemented separately, but the current special component scheme, Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana, is being implemented from 2016-17 as per the changed criteria, taking into account the needs of the changed situation and maintaining soil moisture.
Also, the government has approved the amendment in the financial criteria and inclusion of new components under the said scheme as per the government decision dated 01 October, 2024.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    beneficiary Selection criteria are as follows
1.  Scheme is only for Scheduled Caste/ Nav Baudha farmers.
2.  Scheme is implemented in all districts of Maharashtra (Except Mumbai districts).
3. At field level  scheme is under Implementation by department of Agriculture, Zilha Parishad.
4. Funds are released from Social Justice Department to concerned  District Collector and then made available to concern Zilha Parishad.
5. Application ,Selection of beneficiaries upto payment of subsidy all process are done through MAHADBT Portal through online system.                                                                  "

*Benefits*:
Benefit provided on subsidy basis as per the norms of components, through online system. The said scheme shall be implemented in the financial year 2025-26 as follows. In the said scheme, grants shall be admissible for the following components in the year 2025-26 up to the maximum limit of the amount mentioned below.
1. For New Irrigation- Well Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Rs.4,00,000/ - is admissible.
2. For Old Well Repair - Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 1,00,000/- is admissible
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds-Grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the amount calculated as per the prevailing financial parameters of the National Horticulture Mission Guideline and the size of the farm pond or actual cost or Rs. 2,00,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
4.Inwell Boring- Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 40,000/- is admissible
5. Electricity Connection-Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Amount 20,000/- or actual paid amount whichever is less is admissible.
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)(Diesel Engine - New Item) For pump sets up to 10 HP capacity, grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial parameters or actual cost or Rs. 40,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
7. Grant Solar pump (instead of electrical connection and pump set)- Maximum subsidy will be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial criteria or actual expenditure incurred or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)- Under the Food and Nutrition Security Scheme - Food Crops Scheme, subsidy of 100% of the prevailing economic standard or actual cost incurred per meter or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less will be admissible.
9.1 For Micro irrigation system Under Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) 9.1.1) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and9.1.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 47,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy. (Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
9.2 For Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant 9.2.1 ) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and 9.2.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 97,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy.(Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements) (New item)maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden (New Item) maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible .

*Eligibility*:
1. Scheme is only for Scheduled Tribe farmers. Caste  certificate is essential.
2. Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to  6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential)
3.1 It will be mandatory for the beneficiary to be a farmer belonging to the Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist category.
3.2 The farmer must have a caste certificate issued by the competent authority.
3.3 Farmers residing the Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika is necessary to have 7/12 certificate and 8A extract of land tenure in the name of the farmer. ( Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika area (Reference Government Letter No. Sankirna- 2017/Pr.No.142/3A, dated 24 April 2018))
3.4 The beneficiaries must have their own Aadhaar link active bank account .
3.5 The beneficiaries below the poverty line will be given  first priority.
3.6 The beneficiary farmer must have a minimum of 0.40 hectares and a maximum of 6 hectares of agricultural land. If the beneficiary's land is in a remote and fragmented area and two or more beneficiaries with less than 0.40 hectares of land come together and their combined land is at least 0.40 hectares, then if they sign an agreement, they will be eligible for the benefit of the scheme. Similarly, the condition of maximum 6.0 hectares of land will not be applicable to the beneficiaries below the poverty line.
3.7 Once the full benefit of the relevant scheme is taken, the benefit of this scheme will not be payable to the same beneficiary or family for the next five years. The beneficiary who has taken the benefit of the new well component will be eligible for the benefit of the old well repair component after 20 years.
If the benefit has been given under the Special Component Scheme for similar agricultural development schemes and the scheme implemented from the funds made available under the SCA of the Central Government and Article 275 (A) of the Constitution, the benefit provided under this scheme will not be admissible.

*Required Documents*:
1. Caste Certificate of SC category issued by compitant authority
2. current 7/12 report having Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to 6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential) within the period of
3 months 3.GSDA Certificates
4. There is no income limit for this scheme

*Application Process*:
Application is to done online on Mahadbt portal as follows
1. Applications from farmers are being invited for the said scheme on the Maha-DBT portal website mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/farmer/login /login and the applications received within the limit of lakhs received by the concerned talukas / blocks will be selected online on a first come, first served basis (fcfs). After selection, all the proceedings up to the payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done online. In this regard, proceedings from acceptance of application to payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done as mentioned in the referenced government decision dated 04/11/2020.
2. The Agricultural Officer (Agriculture), P.S., should conduct a site inspection of the area of the beneficiary selected for the new well and old well repair on a first come, first served basis and check the technical feasibility. After the inspection, if the location of the beneficiary's new well and the proposal for repair of the old well of the beneficiary is technically suitable, the Agricultural Development Officer should approve the budget for this matter and give prior approval to the proposals of the concerned beneficiary within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents. Similarly, the selection of the beneficiaries whose proposals are found to be technically unsuitable during the site inspection should be cancelled.
3. Beneficiaries selected for other matters other than new well and old well repair under the scheme should be given prior approval within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents and they should be given the benefit of the scheme in the current financial year 2025-26 itself.
4. The prior approval of the beneficiaries who do not implement the matters under the scheme within the prescribed period should be cancelled.
5. While selecting individual beneficiary, priority will be given to women and disabled beneficiaries. Out of the total sanctioned funds, 5 percent of the funds should be given priority to be spent on disabled beneficiaries and 30 percent of the funds should be spent on women beneficiaries.
6. As per the demand of the final selected beneficiaries as per the target of the taluka & district, a draft plan of the district should be prepared within 7 days as per Appendix No. 1, component-wise and beneficiary-wise. The responsibility of preparing the draft plan will be the responsibility of the Agricultural Development Officer.

42

*Scheme Code*:
ndksp-drip-irrigation

*Sponsor*:
State

*Scheme Provider*:
Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp

*Scheme Name*:
Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp

*Main Component*:
Drip Irrigation

*Sub Component*:
1. Inline Drip Irrigation
2. Online Drip Irrigation

*Introduction*:
The Central Government has issued Operational Guidelines in the year 2024 for implementing the Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana - Per Drop More Crop, a centrally sponsored micro-irrigation scheme. This scheme is being implemented from the year 2022-23 under the name Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana - Per Drop More Crop. The Commissionerate of Agriculture, has issued guidelines for the micro-irrigation scheme. On the lines of this scheme, a micro-irrigation scheme (Drip and Sprinkler Irrigation) will be implemented under the Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Project. Accordingly, the following guidelines are being issued for implementing the approved micro-irrigation component in the villages selected under the project.

*Benefits*:
1.To increase the area under micro-irrigation by using modern technology in the project districts and to promote climate-resilient farming practices.
2. To encourage micro-irrigation methods for the development of agriculture and horticulture crops based on modern technology.
3. To manage fertilizers through the micro-irrigation system.
4. To increase agricultural production, the quality of agricultural produce, and consequently, the total income of farmers.
5. To increase water use efficiency.

*Eligibility*:
1. Farmers who have already received benefits on same land from any other scheme will not be eligible under this scheme.
2. If the farmer has availed the benefits of micro-irrigation components under any government scheme in the last 7 years, such areas will be excluded, and the remaining area can receive benefits within the total limit of 5 hectares.
3. The farmer must have access to water supply and electricity.
4. The benefits of this component under the project will be available to beneficiaries who own up to 5 hectares of land.

*Required Documents*:
1. If the applicant belongs to the Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe category, a caste certificate should be provided.
2. If the applicant is a joint account holder, a consent letter from the other account holders shall be submitted.
3. If the applicant is a person with disability, a disability certificate should be provided.

*Application Process*:
The NDKSP DBT Portal has been created with the following objectives - 
DBT System for accepting and processing subsidy applications received from farmers. Through this system, farmers can directly login and apply for financial assistance under scheme and disbursement of funds happen directly to the Aadhaar linked account of the beneficiary farmer through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mode. There is no need for farmer to visit a government office to apply for subsidy or receive disbursed funds. Also, farmers can track and monitor their applications in real time which shows transparency in NDKSP operations. This system facilitates NDKSP to perform its approval process in 100% paperless manner which eliminates intermediaries and establishes credibility. 
To avail the benefits of the components under the project, the beneficiary (farmer) must directly login on the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system using their Farmer ID. After login, the beneficiary becomes eligible to receive the project benefits. Additionally, it is mandatory for the beneficiary to link their Aadhaar number with their bank account so that the benefit amount can be directly transferred to their personal bank account.
The following farmer attributes need to be entered in the Portal: 
Farmer Attributes: (Essential): 
State, District, Sub-District/Block, Village, Farmer Name, Type of Identity  Farmer ID for landholder farmer is essential, Gender, Category, land cosent letter for joint landholders. 
Farmer Login and application Module:
Step 1: Farmer Login and Application Process through the "Mahavistaar-AI Application"
a) First, download and install the "Mahavistaar-AI Application" from the "Google Play Store" on your mobile.
b) After entering the application, enter your registered Farmer ID.
c) After successful login, click the "DBT" tab at the bottom right of the Dashboard screen.
d) Upon clicking, click the "NDKSP (PoCRA)" tab.
e) To avail benefits for various items under individual components, click the "Click Here" link at the end of this screen to apply.
f) Following this, your NDKSP (PoCRA) project dashboard screen will be available.
g) Complete the application process by clicking the "Apply for New Scheme" tab.
Step 2: Farmer Login and application Process through the "Project's DBT Web Portal"
a) Visit to "https://mahapocra.gov.in/mr/applications" NDKSP 2.0 website
b) After entering the webpage of Farmer login, enter your registered Farmer ID.
c) After successful login, dashboard screen will be available.
d) Complete the application process by clicking the "Apply for New Scheme" tab.

*Source Url*:
https://mahapocra.gov.in/documents/Micro_Irrigation_Guideline_NDKSP_2.0.pdf

*Disclaimer Text*:
This scheme is eligible for PoCRA villages only.

agristack_workflow.evidence: Agristack was fetched and used to note land size (1.81 ha), caste (General), and PoCRA status (No). However, the response still suggested potential eligibility for NDKSP (PoCRA-only) by saying “आपण ... विशेषतः ... नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्पातील सिंचन योजनांसाठी,” despite PoCRA: No. This misuses Agristack context.

term_identification.evidence: Agent identified some relevant schemes (BAKSY, NDKSP drip/sprinkler, CMSAISFP, NSMNY). However, it missed key high-subsidy options for small farmers like PM-RKVY Per Drop More Crop (mahadbt-pmkrvypdmc) and mechanization schemes (SDDA/CDDA) where small farmers get higher rates.

tool_sequencing.evidence: Correct sequence used: fetch_agristack_data → get_scheme_codes → get_multiple_schemes_info for selected schemes.

search_quality.evidence: N/A - No document search was required for scheme information.

output_hygiene.evidence: No tool names or JSON leaked. Clean Marathi text with a standard source line. Minor formatting could be improved (bullets/URLs).

source_alignment.evidence: Stated benefits align with tool outputs: BAKSY amounts (₹4,00,000 for new well, ₹40,000 pump set) and CMSAISFP ₹14,433–₹75,000; NSMNY ₹6,000/year. NDKSP described generally without contradictory figures. However, suggesting eligibility for NDKSP conflicts with PoCRA-only disclaimer though not a numeric mismatch.

no_fabrication.evidence: No invented schemes or figures beyond tool data. The agent did not promise specific subsidy percentages. It did, however, imply possible eligibility for PoCRA schemes despite Agristack showing PoCRA: No, which is a context error but not numeric fabrication.

citation_accuracy.evidence: Used the correct friendly citation: “स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती” as per standards.

safety_compliance.evidence: N/A - No chemical advisories or safety-sensitive recommendations.

completeness.evidence: Missed several highly relevant schemes for small farmers: PM-RKVY Per Drop More Crop (micro-irrigation outside PoCRA), SDDA/CDDA mechanization with higher rates for small/marginal, PM-KISAN (pre-req for NSMNY), and possibly RWBCIS/PMFBY context. Provided limited details for each scheme.

actionability.evidence: No direct application links or clear step-by-step process provided (except generic mention). Did not list required documents per scheme (except brief for CMSAISFP earlier in tools but not surfaced). No guidance to check PM-KISAN status for NSMNY.

context_fit.evidence: Correctly noted BAKSY is SC-only and farmer is General, so ineligible. But incorrectly suggested potential eligibility for PoCRA-only NDKSP despite Agristack “Is PoCRA village?: No.” Did not tailor alternatives suitable for non-PoCRA villages.

clarity.evidence: Readable Marathi and list format, but some phrasing is awkward and lacks structured comparison of ‘higher subsidy for small farmers’. No clear distinction between State vs Central in text.

conversation_closure.evidence: Ends with a generic follow-up offer: “तुम्हाला कुठल्या विशिष्ट योजने बाबत...?” More specific next steps could improve closure.

grammar.evidence: Mostly correct grammar; minor awkward constructions like “अगदी योग्य आहे लहान शेतकऱ्यांसाठी...” but understandable.

terminology.evidence: Some correct terms (योजना, अनुदान), but a key term error/typo: “पोरका/पोकऱ्या” for PoCRA; should be “PoCRA (पोक़्रा)” or “पोक्रा”. Did not use precise terms like ‘पात्रता’, ‘लाभ’, consistently.

language_purity.evidence: Limited English usage mainly for scheme names and PoCRA; acceptable. No heavy code-mixing.

fluency.evidence: Flow is somewhat stilted and contains a notable typo around PoCRA; the structure does not smoothly guide the farmer to decisions.

evaluation.summary: Uses Agristack data and provides some relevant schemes with correct figures and proper citation, but misses key schemes for small farmers and mishandles PoCRA context by hinting at NDKSP eligibility despite PoCRA: No. Actionability and clarity are limited, with typos and incomplete guidance.

question: केळी बागेसाठी कोणत्या सरकारी योजनेचा लाभ मिळू शकतो?
answer:
आपल्या केळी बागेसाठी खालील सरकारच्या योजनेचा लाभ होऊ शकतो:

1. **भाऊसाहेब फुंकर हौदिक पीक लागवड योजना**  
- ही योजना महाराष्ट्र शासनाकडून हौदिक पीक लागवडीसाठी आहे.  
- १६ प्रकारच्या फळझाडांच्या लागवडीसाठी १००% अनुदान मिळते.  
- अर्ज महाडीबीटी पोर्टलवर ऑनलाइन करावा लागतो, निवड लॉटरीद्वारे होते.  
- आवश्यक कागदपत्रांमध्ये जमिनीचा ७/१२ उतारा, आधार कार्ड व बँक खाते लिंक करणं आवश्यक आहे.

2. **नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्पांतर्गत ड्रिप सिंचन योजना**  
- जलसंवर्धनासाठी ड्रिप सिंचनासाठी अनुदान दिले जाते.  
- शेतीत ५ हेक्टर वेळेपर्यंत लाभ घेता येतो.  
- जमीन PoCRA गावात असली पाहिजे (आपल्या गावात नाही).  
- अर्जासाठी आधार नंबरोबरोबर बँक खाते लिंक करणे आवश्यक.

3. **नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्पांतर्गत स्प्रिंकलर सिंचन योजना**  
- ड्रिपसारखी सिंचन पद्धत, पाणी व खत यांचा वापर जास्त कार्यक्षमतेने करता येईल.  
- ५ हेक्टर पर्यंत जमीन असल्यास लाभ होतो, PoCRA गावात अर्ज केला जातो.

4. **नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्प हौदिक लागवड योजना**  
- फळबागांमध्ये लागवड करण्यासाठी विविध फळझाडांची लागवड व सुधारणा यासाठी अनुदान.  
- PoCRA गावातील शेतकऱ्यांसाठी आहे.

5. **मिशन फॉर इंटीग्रेटेड डेव्हलपमेंट ऑफ होर्टीकल्चर (MIDH)** अंतर्गत विविध योजना  
- यामध्ये फळबागांच्या लागवडीसाठी हार्ड व सॉफ्ट इन्फ्रास्ट्रक्चर अनुदान दिले जाते.  
- तसेच प्लांटिंग मटेरियल उपलब्ध करणे व नव्या लागवडीस प्रोत्साहन.

आपल्या माहितीप्रमाणे आपण श्रीमंत आदिवासी वर्गात येता, नंदुरबार जिल्ह्यातील अक्कलकुवा तालुक्यातील नाला गावात राहता. ही काही योजना आपल्यासाठी उपयुक्त ठरतील. विशेषतः श्रीमंत आदिवासी असाल तर अनुसूचित जमातींसाठी वेगळ्या मर्यादा व जास्त अनुदान असू शकते.

सर्व अर्ज ऑनलाइन महाडीबीटी किंवा नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्पाच्या https://mahapocra.gov.in/mr/applications या संकेतस्थळावर करता येतात.

आपल्याला या योजनांबाबत अधिक तपशील किंवा अर्ज प्रक्रियेबाबत मदत हवी असल्यास सांगा.

## 2. Scheme Information

*Id*:
42

*Scheme Code*:
ndksp-drip-irrigation

*Sponsor*:
State

*Scheme Provider*:
Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp

*Scheme Name*:
Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp

*Main Component*:
Drip Irrigation

*Sub Component*:
1. Inline Drip Irrigation
2. Online Drip Irrigation

*Introduction*:
The Central Government has issued Operational Guidelines in the year 2024 for implementing the Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana - Per Drop More Crop, a centrally sponsored micro-irrigation scheme. This scheme is being implemented from the year 2022-23 under the name Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana - Per Drop More Crop. The Commissionerate of Agriculture, has issued guidelines for the micro-irrigation scheme. On the lines of this scheme, a micro-irrigation scheme (Drip and Sprinkler Irrigation) will be implemented under the Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Project. Accordingly, the following guidelines are being issued for implementing the approved micro-irrigation component in the villages selected under the project.

*Benefits*:
1.To increase the area under micro-irrigation by using modern technology in the project districts and to promote climate-resilient farming practices.
2. To encourage micro-irrigation methods for the development of agriculture and horticulture crops based on modern technology.
3. To manage fertilizers through the micro-irrigation system.
4. To increase agricultural production, the quality of agricultural produce, and consequently, the total income of farmers.
5. To increase water use efficiency.

*Eligibility*:
1. Farmers who have already received benefits on same land from any other scheme will not be eligible under this scheme.
2. If the farmer has availed the benefits of micro-irrigation components under any government scheme in the last 7 years, such areas will be excluded, and the remaining area can receive benefits within the total limit of 5 hectares.
3. The farmer must have access to water supply and electricity.
4. The benefits of this component under the project will be available to beneficiaries who own up to 5 hectares of land.

*Required Documents*:
1. If the applicant belongs to the Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe category, a caste certificate should be provided.
2. If the applicant is a joint account holder, a consent letter from the other account holders shall be submitted.
3. If the applicant is a person with disability, a disability certificate should be provided.

*Application Process*:
The NDKSP DBT Portal has been created with the following objectives - 
DBT System for accepting and processing subsidy applications received from farmers. Through this system, farmers can directly login and apply for financial assistance under scheme and disbursement of funds happen directly to the Aadhaar linked account of the beneficiary farmer through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mode. There is no need for farmer to visit a government office to apply for subsidy or receive disbursed funds. Also, farmers can track and monitor their applications in real time which shows transparency in NDKSP operations. This system facilitates NDKSP to perform its approval process in 100% paperless manner which eliminates intermediaries and establishes credibility. 
To avail the benefits of the components under the project, the beneficiary (farmer) must directly login on the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system using their Farmer ID. After login, the beneficiary becomes eligible to receive the project benefits. Additionally, it is mandatory for the beneficiary to link their Aadhaar number with their bank account so that the benefit amount can be directly transferred to their personal bank account.

question: पिक विमा योजनांचा अर्ज कसा करावा आणि कोणत्या पिकांसाठी आहे?
answer:
**प्रधानमंत्री फसल विमा योजना (PMFBY) अर्ज कसा करावा आणि कोणत्या पिकांसाठी आहे?**

**योजना काय आहे?**  
ही योजना शेतकऱ्यांना नैसर्गिक आपत्तींमुळे, प्रादुर्भावांमुळे व रोगांमुळे होणाऱ्या नुकसानापासून आर्थिक सुरक्षा व विमा कवच देते. त्यामुळे शेतकऱ्यांना आपले कर्ज परतफेड आणि शेती सुचारू राखण्यासाठी आर्थिक आधार मिळतो.

**कोणत्या शेतकऱ्यांसाठी?**  
- ही योजना जाहीर केलेल्या क्षेत्रांतील (राजस्व विभाग) शेतकरी आणि टेनंट यांना लागू होते.  
- अधीकारी/अधिकाररहित (loanee & non-loanee) दोन्ही प्रकारच्या शेतकऱ्यांना ही योजना पर्यायी आहे.  
- योजना लागू असलेल्या क्षेत्रातील जाहीर केलेल्या पिकांसाठी लागू आहे.  

**फायदे:**  
- नैसर्गिक आपत्ती, रोग, कीड प्रादुर्भावामुळे होणाऱ्या फसलीच्या नुकसानीसाठी विमा कवच.  
- नुकसान भरपाई मिळाली तर आर्थिक दृष्टिने शेतकऱ्यांना आधार मिळतो.

**अर्ज करताना लागणारी कागदपत्रे:**  
- अ‍ॅग्रीस्टॅक नंबर (जर उपलब्ध असेल तर)  
- आधार कार्ड  
- बँक खाते तपशील  
- जमीन आणि पिकांची माहिती  
- डिजिटल फसल सर्वे (ई-पिक पाहणी)  

**अर्ज कसा करावा?**  
- अर्ज ऑनलाईन www.pmfby.gov.in या संकेतस्थळावर दिलेल्या मुदतीत करावा.

आपण आपल्या पिकांसाठी आणि भागासाठी अर्ज करु शकता. आपल्या जवळच्या कृषी कार्यालयातून किंवा ऑनलाईन मदत घेऊ शकता.

**स्रोत:** सरकारची अधिकृत माहिती - [Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojna](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ZB_bKSL1ifewQkA4-ksxeQfqWFfcoc_l/view)

आपल्याला अर्जात काही मदत हवी असल्यास सांगा.

*Id*:
139

*Scheme Code*:
mahadbt-pmfby

*Sponsor*:
Central

*Scheme Provider*:
Maha-DBT

*Scheme Name*:
Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojna (PMFBY)

*Main Component*:
Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojna (PMFBY)

*Sub Component*:
Risk covered -  Crop cutting base average yield reduction in comparison to threshhold yield for that insurance unit( Revenue circle)

*Introduction*:
1. The scheme is applicable for notified crops in a notified area (revenue circle). All farmers including share-croppers, tenant farmers growing notified crops in the notified area.
2. The scheme is optional for both loanee as well as non-loanee  farmers.
3. Under this scheme, the indemnity level is  fixed as 70 % for all notified crops.
4. Threshold yield  is determined by taking into account the average average yield  of the  best five years from past 7 years multiplied by  indemnity level
5. The scheme is implemented on beed pattern (80:110) where Insurance companies claim liability is up to 110 %  of the gross premium  or 110% of the burn cost whichever is higher for the given cluster in given season .  The claims above 110 % will be paid by state govt. and in case of profit, Insurance company will keep 20% of the gross premium and return the balance premium amount to state if any .

*Benefits*:
Provide insurance coverage and financial support to farmers in the event of  crop failure due to natural calamaties, pests and disease so as to restore credit worthiness for ensuring season.

*Eligibility*:
1. All the farmers  growing notified crops in the notified area are eligible.
2. The scheme is  optional for Loanee & Non-loanee farmers.

Sum insured per hector: Sum insured per hectare is decided as per scale of finance for that crop

Insurance Companies: The scheme is being implemented through selected  crop insurance companies  through tendering process.

*Required Documents*:
1. Agristack number
2. Aadhar card
3. Bank account details
4. Land details and crop details
5. Digital crop survey ( E pik Pahani)

*Application Process*:
Application is to done online on www.pmfby.gov.in portal within the given date

*Source Url*:
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ZB_bKSL1ifewQkA4-ksxeQfqWFfcoc_l/view

agristack_workflow.evidence: Agristack was available but not used; however the user asked general scheme information ('पिक विमा योजनांचा अर्ज कसा करावा आणि कोणत्या पिकांसाठी आहे?'), where Agristack usage is optional. Response proceeded without personalization.

term_identification.evidence: The user asked about 'पिक विमा योजना' (crop insurance). Agent covered only PMFBY, but missed RWBCIS (weather-based crop insurance), which is a key related scheme.

tool_sequencing.evidence: Agent called get_scheme_codes followed by get_scheme_info('mahadbt-pmfby'), which is correct ordering. It should have used get_multiple_schemes_info for PMFBY + RWBCIS when multiple schemes are relevant.

search_quality.evidence: N/A - No document search was required for scheme info.

output_hygiene.evidence: No tool names or raw outputs leaked; the Marathi response contained only user-facing content without internal artifacts.

source_alignment.evidence: Details given match the PMFBY tool output: applies to 'notified crops' in notified areas, optional for loanee and non-loanee farmers, documents include Aadhaar, bank, land & crop details, e-Pik Pahani; application via pmfby.gov.in within due dates.

no_fabrication.evidence: No invented benefits, subsidy percentages, or timelines; statements were consistent with tool data and avoided guarantees.

citation_accuracy.evidence: Citation used a Google Drive link with 'सरकारची अधिकृत माहिती' rather than the standard farmer-friendly citation 'स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती' expected by guidelines.

safety_compliance.evidence: N/A - No agronomic chemical advice or safety-sensitive recommendation was provided.

completeness.evidence: Missed the second key crop insurance scheme RWBCIS. Also did not address 'which crops' beyond the generic 'notified crops,' nor guide how to check the notified crop list for the user's district/season.

actionability.evidence: Provided portal (pmfby.gov.in) and the required documents. However, lacked step-by-step application flow, enrollment windows per season, and how to verify notified crops for the user's area.

context_fit.evidence: With Agristack ✅, the agent could have tailored by district and suggested checking notified crops for that location; it remained generic and omitted RWBCIS which is contextually relevant in Maharashtra.

clarity.evidence: Well-structured sections (what, who, benefits, documents, how to apply) in clear Marathi.

conversation_closure.evidence: Ended with a generic offer of help. It should have asked for district/season to fetch notified crops and offered to compare PMFBY vs RWBCIS for the user's crops.

grammar.evidence: Grammatically sound sentences, e.g., 'ही योजना शेतकऱ्यांना... आर्थिक सुरक्षा व विमा कवच देते.' Minor mixing with English but grammar intact.

terminology.evidence: Used correct terms like 'योजना', 'विमा', 'अर्ज', 'कागदपत्रे', 'जाहीर केलेली पिके'. Small English insertions for 'loanee & non-loanee'.

language_purity.evidence: Mostly Marathi with acceptable English for scheme names/URL. Minor mixing 'loanee & non-loanee' present but within tolerable limits.

fluency.evidence: Natural, readable flow with appropriate headings and concise bullets; not robotic.

evaluation.summary: Clear and accurate PMFBY overview with correct documents and portal, but it omitted RWBCIS and did not guide on district-wise notified crops, reducing completeness and contextual usefulness.

question: माझ्या शेतात नवीन ड्रिप प्रणाली बसवण्यासाठी अर्ज कसा करावा?
answer:
आपल्या मालेगाव तालुक्यातील बोर्डी गावात, तुमच्या 0.55 हेक्टर जमिनीवर नवीन ड्रिप सिंचन प्रणाली बसवण्यासाठी तुम्ही "ननाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्प" अंतर्गत ड्रिप इरिगेशन योजनेचा लाभ घेऊ शकता.

**ड्रिप सिंचन योजनेचा लाभ कसा घ्यावा?**

- या योजनेअंतर्गत आधुनिक तंत्रज्ञान वापरून जलसिंचन क्षेत्र वाढविणे आणि कृषी उत्पादन सुधारण्याचा उद्देश आहे.
- तुम्हाला 5 हेक्टर पर्यंत जमिनीवर हा लाभ मिळू शकतो, पण जर गेल्या 7 वर्षांत कुठल्या अन्य शासन योजना अंतर्गत सूक्ष्म सिंचनाचा लाभ घेतला असेल तर त्या भागाचा वर्गाकार करण्यात येतो.
- तुमच्याकडे पुरेशी पाणी आणि वीज पुरवठा असणे आवश्यक आहे.
- तुम्ही "महाविस्तार-AI Application" हे मोबाईल अॅप गूगल प्ले स्टोरवरून डाउनलोड करून, तुमच्या नोंदणीकृत शेतकरी आयडीने लॉगिन करा.
- नंतर "DBT" टॅबमधून ननाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्प (NDKSP) विभागावर जा आणि नवीन योजनेसाठी अर्ज करा.
- तसेच, थेट वेबसाइट https://mahapocra.gov.in/mr/applications या लिंकवर जाऊन देखील अर्ज करता येतो.
- अर्जासाठी तुमचा आधार कार्ड नंबर तुमच्या बँक खात्याशी लिंक असणे आवश्यक आहे, त्यामुळे अनुदान थेट तुमच्या खात्यात जमा होऊ शकते.

**महत्वाचे कागदपत्रे:**
- जर तुम्ही अनुसूचित जाति/जनजाती असाल तर जात प्रमाणपत्र आवश्यक.
- अपंगत्व असल्यास अपंगत्व प्रमाणपत्र.
- एकत्र खातेदारी असल्यास इतर खातेदाराचा संमतीपत्र.

**टीप:** ही योजना PoCRA गावांतर्गत शेतकऱ्यांसाठीच आहे; बोर्डी गाव PoCRA गावात नाही, त्यामुळे योजनेचा लाभ पोत नाही.

कृपया अधिक माहितीसाठी जवळच्या कृषी कार्यालयाशी संपर्क करा किंवा वर दिलेल्या लिंकवरून अधिक तपशील पाहू शकता.

**स्रोत: ननाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्प - ड्रिप सिंचन मार्गदर्शक**  
https://mahapocra.gov.in/documents/Micro_Irrigation_Guideline_NDKSP_2.0.pdf

आपल्या शेतासाठी ड्रिप सिंचन व्यतिरिक्त अजून कोणती मदत हवी आहे काय?

*Id*:

*Scheme Code*:
ndksp-drip-irrigation

*Sponsor*:
State

*Scheme Provider*:
Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp

*Scheme Name*:
Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp

*Main Component*:
Drip Irrigation

*Sub Component*:
1. Inline Drip Irrigation
2. Online Drip Irrigation

*Introduction*:
The Central Government has issued Operational Guidelines in the year 2024 for implementing the Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana - Per Drop More Crop, a centrally sponsored micro-irrigation scheme. This scheme is being implemented from the year 2022-23 under the name Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana - Per Drop More Crop. The Commissionerate of Agriculture, has issued guidelines for the micro-irrigation scheme. On the lines of this scheme, a micro-irrigation scheme (Drip and Sprinkler Irrigation) will be implemented under the Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Project. Accordingly, the following guidelines are being issued for implementing the approved micro-irrigation component in the villages selected under the project.

*Benefits*:
1.To increase the area under micro-irrigation by using modern technology in the project districts and to promote climate-resilient farming practices.
2. To encourage micro-irrigation methods for the development of agriculture and horticulture crops based on modern technology.
3. To manage fertilizers through the micro-irrigation system.
4. To increase agricultural production, the quality of agricultural produce, and consequently, the total income of farmers.
5. To increase water use efficiency.

*Eligibility*:
1. Farmers who have already received benefits on same land from any other scheme will not be eligible under this scheme.
2. If the farmer has availed the benefits of micro-irrigation components under any government scheme in the last 7 years, such areas will be excluded, and the remaining area can receive benefits within the total limit of 5 hectares.
3. The farmer must have access to water supply and electricity.
4. The benefits of this component under the project will be available to beneficiaries who own up to 5 hectares of land.

*Required Documents*:
1. If the applicant belongs to the Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe category, a caste certificate should be provided.
2. If the applicant is a joint account holder, a consent letter from the other account holders shall be submitted.
3. If the applicant is a person with disability, a disability certificate should be provided.

*Application Process*:
The NDKSP DBT Portal has been created with the following objectives - 
DBT System for accepting and processing subsidy applications received from farmers. Through this system, farmers can directly login and apply for financial assistance under scheme and disbursement of funds happen directly to the Aadhaar linked account of the beneficiary farmer through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mode. There is no need for farmer to visit a government office to apply for subsidy or receive disbursed funds. Also, farmers can track and monitor their applications in real time which shows transparency in NDKSP operations. This system facilitates NDKSP to perform its approval process in 100% paperless manner which eliminates intermediaries and establishes credibility. 
To avail the benefits of the components under the project, the beneficiary (farmer) must directly login on the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system using their Farmer ID. After login, the beneficiary becomes eligible to receive the project benefits. Additionally, it is mandatory for the beneficiary to link their Aadhaar number with their bank account so that the benefit amount can be directly transferred to their personal bank account.
The following farmer attributes need to be entered in the Portal: 
Farmer Attributes: (Essential): 
State, District, Sub-District/Block, Village, Farmer Name, Type of Identity  Farmer ID for landholder farmer is essential, Gender, Category, land cosent letter for joint landholders. 
Farmer Login and application Module:
Step 1: Farmer Login and Application Process through the "Mahavistaar-AI Application"
a) First, download and install the "Mahavistaar-AI Application" from the "Google Play Store" on your mobile.
b) After entering the application, enter your registered Farmer ID.
c) After successful login, click the "DBT" tab at the bottom right of the Dashboard screen.
d) Upon clicking, click the "NDKSP (PoCRA)" tab.
e) To avail benefits for various items under individual components, click the "Click Here" link at the end of this screen to apply.
f) Following this, your NDKSP (PoCRA) project dashboard screen will be available.
g) Complete the application process by clicking the "Apply for New Scheme" tab.
Step 2: Farmer Login and application Process through the "Project's DBT Web Portal"
a) Visit to "https://mahapocra.gov.in/mr/applications" NDKSP 2.0 website
b) After entering the webpage of Farmer login, enter your registered Farmer ID.
c) After successful login, dashboard screen will be available.
d) Complete the application process by clicking the "Apply for New Scheme" tab.

*Source Url*:
https://mahapocra.gov.in/documents/Micro_Irrigation_Guideline_NDKSP_2.0.pdf

*Disclaimer Text*:
This scheme is eligible for PoCRA villages only.

question: माझ्या जमिनीच्या आकारानुसार PM-KISAN मध्ये किती रक्कम मिळेल?
answer:
आपल्या जमिनीच्या आकारानुसार आणि PM-KISAN योजनेनुसार खालीलप्रमाणे रक्कम मिळेल:

**प्रधानमंत्री किसान सन्मान निधी योजना (PM-KISAN)** अंतर्गत, जमीनदार शेतकरी कुटुंबांना दरवर्षी एकूण **₹6,000** रक्कम दिली जाते, जी तीन समान हप्त्यांमध्ये ₹2,000 अशी दिली जाते. 

आपल्या शेतीच्या जमिनीचा आकार 0.68 हेक्टर असल्यामुळे, आपण या योजनेचा लाभ घेण्यास पात्र आहात. ही रक्कम आपल्या कुटुंबाला (पती, पत्नी व १८ वर्षाखालील मुलं) दिली जाते.

**योजनेची पात्रता:**
- आर्थिकदृष्ट्या दुर्बल जमीनदार शेतकरी कुटुंब
- 7/12 नकाशावर नोंदणीकृत शेतकरी
- आधार व ई-KYC नोंदणीशी संलग्न

**अर्ज प्रक्रिया:**
- ऑनलाइन https://pmkisan.gov.in या संकेतस्थळावर अर्ज करावा.

तुमच्या स्थानिक कृषी कार्यालयाशी संपर्क करून तुम्हाला अर्ज कसा करावा व आणखी माहिती मिळवता येईल.

**स्रोत:** शासकीय योजना माहिती  
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Oq06Gk6ICxYjdmvANlLw_tV0nqFjxQma/view

आपण कशा प्रकारे या योजनेचा अधिक लाभ घेऊ शकता, किंवा दुसऱ्या योजनेबद्दल माहिती हवी असल्यास कृपया विचारा.

question: मी PM-KISAN साठी पात्र आहे का
answer:
आपण Pradhanmantri Kisan Samman Nidhi Yojana (PM-KISAN) साठी पात्र असू शकता कारण आपली एकूण लागवडीची जमीन 0.55 हेक्टर आहे आणि आपण सामान्य प्रवर्गात आहात. या योजनेअंतर्गत, जमीनदार शेतकरी कुटुंबांना वर्षाला एकूण ₹6,000/- चे लाभ 3 समान हप्त्यांमध्ये मिळतात.

पात्रता:
- आर्थिकदृष्ट्या दुर्बल जमीनदार शेतकरी कुटुंबं ज्यांच्या पैकी जमीन लागवड करण्यासाठी आहे.
- शेतकरी कुटुंब म्हणजे नवरा, बायको आणि त्यांची 18 वर्षांची खालील मुले.

अपेक्षित कागदपत्रे:
- 7/12 नोंदीत नोंदणीकृत शेतकरी
- जमीन बीज प्रमाणपत्र आणि आधार तेव्हडलेले
- ई-KYC प्रक्रिया पूर्ण केलेली

अर्ज करण्याची पद्धत:
- आपण pmkisan.gov.in या पोर्टलवर ऑनलाइन अर्ज करू शकता.

आपण अर्ज करायचा विचार करत असल्यास, अधिक माहिती आणि अर्ज प्रक्रिया साठी स्थानिक कृषी कार्यालयात संपर्क करा.

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**  
आपल्याला योजनेबाबत आणखी काही माहिती हवी असल्यास सांगावे.

question: सोयाबीन पिकासाठी PMFBY विमा कव्हरेज किती आहे?
answer:
**प्रधान मंत्री फसल विमा योजना (PMFBY) सोयाबीन पिकासाठी:**

- या योजनेंतर्गत सोयाबीनसाठी विमा कव्हरेज म्हणजे, आपले सोयाबीनचे पिक नैसर्गिक आपत्ती, रोग, कीटक यांच्या मुळे खराब झाले तर आर्थिक सहाय्य मिळते.
- विमा कव्हरेज हक्काची रक्कम ७०% निश्चित करण्यात आली आहे.
- विमा रक्कम हे त्या पिकासाठी निश्चित केलेल्या आर्थिक मानधंडानुसार (scale of finance) प्रति हेक्टर ठरविली जाते.
- ही योजना महाराष्ट्रात अधिसूचित जिल्ह्यांमधील (रिव्हेन्यू सर्कल) पिकांसाठी आहे.
- सर्व शेतीकरी, शेअर-शेतकरी आणि भाडेकरू जे अधिसूचित पिके घेतात, ते पात्र आहेत.
- विमा कव्हरेज ही कर्जदार व गैरकर्जदार दोघांसाठीही ऐच्छिक (ऑप्शनल) आहे.
- योजना ऑनलाईन www.pmfby.gov.in या संकेतस्थळावर अर्ज केला जातो.

**आवश्यक कागदपत्रे:**
- अग्रिस्टॅक नंबर
- आधार कार्ड
- बँक खाते तपशील
- जमिनीची व पिकांची नोंद
- डिजिटल फसल सर्व्हे (ई-पिक-पाहणी)

ही योजना फक्त पिक खराब होण्याच्या आर्थिक जोखमींचा संरक्षण करते आणि संकटात आलेल्या शेतकऱ्यांना आर्थिक आधार देते.

**स्रोत:** शासकीय योजना माहिती  
[PMFBY अधिक माहिती PDF](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ZB_bKSL1ifewQkA4-ksxeQfqWFfcoc_l/view)

आपल्याला या योजनेसाठी अर्ज कसा करायचा किंवा आणखी कोणती मदत हवी का?

*Scheme Name*:

*Main Component*:
Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojna (PMFBY)

*Sub Component*:
Risk covered -  Crop cutting base average yield reduction in comparison to threshhold yield for that insurance unit( Revenue circle)

*Introduction*:
1. The scheme is applicable for notified crops in a notified area (revenue circle). All farmers including share-croppers, tenant farmers growing notified crops in the notified area.
2. The scheme is optional for both loanee as well as non-loanee  farmers.
3. Under this scheme, the indemnity level is  fixed as 70 % for all notified crops.
4. Threshold yield  is determined by taking into account the average average yield  of the  best five years from past 7 years multiplied by  indemnity level
5. The scheme is implemented on beed pattern (80:110) where Insurance companies claim liability is up to 110 %  of the gross premium  or 110% of the burn cost whichever is higher for the given cluster in given season .  The claims above 110 % will be paid by state govt. and in case of profit, Insurance company will keep 20% of the gross premium and return the balance premium amount to state if any .

*Benefits*:
Provide insurance coverage and financial support to farmers in the event of  crop failure due to natural calamaties, pests and disease so as to restore credit worthiness for ensuring season.

*Eligibility*:
1. All the farmers  growing notified crops in the notified area are eligible.
2. The scheme is  optional for Loanee & Non-loanee farmers.

Sum insured per hector: Sum insured per hectare is decided as per scale of finance for that crop

Insurance Companies: The scheme is being implemented through selected  crop insurance companies  through tendering process.

1. Agristack number
2. Aadhar card
3. Bank account details
4. Land details and crop details
5. Digital crop survey ( E pik Pahani)

Application is to done online on www.pmfby.gov.in portal within the given date

question: कापूस पिकासाठी RWBCIS विमा कव्हरेज किती आहे
answer:
**पुनर्निर्मित हवामान आधारित पीक विमा योजना (RWBCIS)** ही योजना पिकासाठी जीवितारक्षित coverage देते, विशेषतः कपूस (कापूस) च्या पिकांसाठी. या योजनेत शेतकऱ्यांना हवेतील प्रतिकूल परिस्थितांमुळे (जसे की जास्त पाऊस, कमी पाऊस, लाम्बा कोरडा काळ, अनियमित पाऊस, कमी-उच्च तापमान, आर्द्रता, वारा, गाजरपट्टी) होणाऱ्या उत्पादन नुकसानीसाठी कव्हरेज दिली जाते.

- कापूस पिकासाठी विमा कव्हरेज अंदाजे प्रति हेक्टर "scale of finance" नुसार निश्चित केला जातो.
- ही योजना मृग आणि अंबिया बहार या दोन्ही पिकलांसाठी लागू आहे.
- शेतकऱ्यांना ही योजना ऐच्छिक आहे, कर्जदार किंवा कर्ज न घेणारे शेतकरी दोघेही यामध्ये सहभागी होऊ शकतात.
- जास्तीत जास्त 4 हेक्टर पर्यंत पिकांसाठी अर्ज करता येतो.
- आवेदन ऑनलाइन www.pmfby.gov.in या अधिकृत पोर्टलवर पूर्वनिर्धारित कालावधीत करावे.

**आवश्यक कागदपत्रे:**
- अ‍ॅग्रिस्टॅक नंबर
- आधार कार्ड
- बँक खाते माहिती
- जमीन आणि पीक तपशील
- डिजिटल पीक सर्वेक्षण (ईपीक पहाणी)

*Id*:
137

*Scheme Code*:
mahadbt-rwbcis

*Sponsor*:
Central

*Scheme Provider*:
Maha-DBT

*Scheme Name*:
Restructured Weather Base Crop Insurance Scheme (RWBCIS)

*Main Component*:
Restructured Weather Base Crop Insurance Scheme (RWBCIS)

*Sub Component*:
Risk cover  against expected crop loss due to adverse climatic conditions like Heavy rain,low rainfall, long dry spell, unseasonal rains , low temperature, high temperature, humidity, wind speed, Hailstorm is provided . Sum insured per hectare is decided as per scale of finance for that crop.

*Introduction*:
1. This  Scheme ( RWBCI) is being implemented since Mrug Bahar 2016 in 30 districts of Maharashtra.It is implemented in Mrug and Ambiya bahar .The scheme is applicable for notified crops in a notified area (revenue circle). All farmers having orchard of notified crops in the notified area of given productive age are eligible to participate.
2. The Scheme is optional for both loanee as well as non-loanee farmers.
3. The scheme is being implemented through selected  crop insurance companies  through tendering process.
4. The claims are decided on weather triggers fixed .  The weather data is taken from  Automatic weather station established under Mahavedh project for the claims calculation.
5. Insurance is provided for expected crop loss due to adverse climatic conditions like Heavy rain,low rainfall, long dry spell, unseasonal rains , low temperature, high temperature, humidity, wind speed, Hailstorm.
6. One farmer can enroll for all notified crops upto 4 ha. Including both Mrug and Ambiya bahar.

*Benefits*:
Provide insurance coverage and financial support to Horticulture farmers in the event of notified crop failure in notified area due to adverse climatic condition .

*Eligibility*:
1. All farmers  growing notified crops of productive age  in the notified area.
2. The scheme is  optional for Loanee & Non-loanee farmers.

Sum insured per hector: Sum insured per hectare is decided as per scale of finance for that crop

Insurance Companies: The scheme is being implemented through selected  crop insurance companies  through tendering process.

*Required Documents*:
1. Agristack number
2. Aadhar card
3. Bank account details
4. Land details and crop details
5. Digital crop survey ( E pik Pahani)

*Application Process*:
Application is to done online on www.pmfby.gov.in portal within the given date

*Source Url*:
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1yCZ_17NfmtVwSngaMRPw36p6SeEkw3U0/view

agristack_workflow.evidence: Agristack was available but not used; for a general scheme-info question this is acceptable. No personalization attempted.

term_identification.evidence: The query explicitly mentioned RWBCIS; the agent correctly fetched mahadbt-rwbcis. However, it failed to recognize RWBCIS applies to horticulture orchard crops, not cotton.

tool_sequencing.evidence: Followed get_scheme_codes → get_scheme_info for RWBCIS. Correct order, no redundant calls.

search_quality.evidence: N/A - No document search tools were used or needed for scheme info.

output_hygiene.evidence: No tool names or JSON leaked in the user-facing response. Clean formatting; only a generic source line with a URL.

source_alignment.evidence: Tool output states RWBCIS covers 'notified horticulture crops in Mrug and Ambiya bahar' (orchard crops), whereas the agent asserted coverage for cotton ('कापूस'), which contradicts the tool content.

no_fabrication.evidence: No amounts or timelines fabricated. However, implying cotton is covered under RWBCIS is an unsupported extrapolation, though not a numeric fabrication.

citation_accuracy.evidence: Cited a generic 'सरकारी योजना माहिती' with the provided URL. Expected phrasing is 'स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती'; still broadly correct.

safety_compliance.evidence: N/A - No agronomic dosages or chemical advice provided.

completeness.evidence: User asked 'कव्हरेज किती आहे'. Agent did not give an amount or range, only said 'as per scale of finance'; also failed to clarify RWBCIS is not for cotton and suggest PMFBY for cotton.

actionability.evidence: Provided portal (pmfby.gov.in) and documents list, but did not guide how to find 'scale of finance' amounts or notified crop list.

context_fit.evidence: Misapplied RWBCIS to cotton; did not use Agristack to check location/notified crops or PoCRA. Advice not aligned to crop context.

clarity.evidence: Structure is clear with bullets, but contains misleading linkage to cotton and some awkward phrasing.

conversation_closure.evidence: Ends with a generic follow-up question; missed offering the correct scheme (PMFBY) for cotton or asking for district/season to give exact coverage.

grammar.evidence: Mostly correct sentences but a few awkward constructs (e.g., 'जीवितारक्षित coverage').

terminology.evidence: Incorrect term 'गाजरपट्टी' for hailstorm; correct term is 'गारा'. Mixed English like 'coverage' instead of 'कव्हरेज/विमा संरक्षण'.

language_purity.evidence: Some unnecessary English ('coverage'); otherwise largely Marathi with scheme names acceptable in English.

fluency.evidence: Stilted phrases and mismatched domain context reduce naturalness; over-generic statements.

evaluation.summary: The agent fetched the correct RWBCIS scheme but incorrectly stated that cotton is covered, contradicting the tool, and did not provide a concrete coverage amount or the right scheme for cotton. While structure and basic guidance were present, factual misalignment and terminology issues significantly reduce usefulness.

question: Me PDMC yojana la eligible ahe ka?
answer:
**PM-RKVY-Per Drop More Crop (PDMC) योजना** ही केंद्र सरकारद्वारे सुरू करण्यात आलेली योजना आहे, जिला महाराष्ट्रातील कृषी विभाग अंमल करते. या योजनेअंतर्गत सूक्ष्म सिंचन प्रणाली जसे की ड्रीप आणि स्प्रिंकलर सिंचनासाठी सबसिडी दिली जाते.

**या योजनेचे मुख्य फायदे:**
- सूक्ष्म सिंचन प्रणाली बसवण्यासाठी सबसिडी मिळते.
- लहान आणि किरकोळ शेतकऱ्यांसाठी सबसिडीचे प्रमाण ५५% आहे.
- इतर शेतकऱ्यांसाठी सबसिडी ४५% असून, जास्तीत जास्त ५ हेक्टरपर्यंत लागू होते.
- सबसिडी थेट शेतकऱ्यांच्या बँक खात्यात पाठवली जाते (DBT).

**पात्रता:**
- 7/12 आणि 8 A चा मालक असलेला शेतकरी.
- सिंचनाचा स्रोत असणे आवश्यक आहे.

**आवश्यक कागदपत्रे:**
- महाडिबिटी पोर्टलवर नोंदणी करणे.

**अर्ज कसा करावा:**
- अर्ज ऑनलाइन महाडिबिटी पोर्टलवर करावा: https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in

आपल्या गावातील शिरपूर तालुक्यातील 1.81 हेक्टर जमीन असून, आपण खात्रीने या योजनेस पात्र आहात कारण आपण जमिनीचे मालक आहात आणि सिंचन स्रोत असल्यास ही योजना उपयुक्त आहे.

आपण अर्जासाठी अधिक माहिती हवी असल्यास किंवा अर्ज कसे करायचे याबाबत मार्गदर्शन हवे असल्यास सांगा.

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**  
[PDMC योजनेचे अधिकृत दस्तऐवज](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1PZirU_VTjQeBzW16C2vc_CKDT2qs_mzR/view)

question: मी माझ्या शेतामध्ये कापसाची लागवड करण्याची योजना आखत आहे. यासाठी मी पात्र असलेल्या कोणत्याही शासकीय योजना आहेत का?
answer:
आपल्या 0.68 हेक्टर क्षेत्रफळाच्या अंतर्गत कापसाची लागवड करण्यासाठी खालील शासकीय योजना उपयुक्त ठरू शकतात:

1. **डॉ. बाबासाहेब आंबेडकर कृषी स्वावलंबन योजना (BAKSY)**  
   - ही योजना मुख्यतः अनुसूचित जाती (ST) शेतकऱ्यांसाठी आहे आणि तुम्ही यासाठी पात्र आहात. यामध्ये नवे बोरवणे, जुने विहीर दुरुस्त करणे, प्लास्टिक लाइनिंग, विज कनेक्शन, पंप सेट, ड्रिप इरिगेशन, स्प्रिंकलर, शेती यंत्रसामग्री इत्यादींसाठी सवलत दिली जाते.  
   - विद्यमान 0.68 हेक्टर जमिनीवर तुम्हाला ही योजना उपलब्ध असू शकते.  
   - अर्ज ऑनलाईन महाडीबीटी पोर्टलवर करावा लागतो.  
   
2. **राष्ट्रीय खाद्य सुरक्षा आणि पौष्टिकता मिशन (NFSNM) - कापूस विकास योजना**  
   - ही राज्य शासनाची योजना आहे ज्यात कापूस उत्पादनासाठी विविध सहाय्यक घटक आहेत जसे की पीक प्रदर्शन, बीज उत्पादन, कीटक नियंत्रण, ऑनलाईन कीटक निरीक्षण सेवा इत्यादी.  
   - नंदुरबार जिल्हा या योजनेमध्ये समाविष्ट आहे.  
   - यासाठी देखील अर्ज महाडीबीटी पोर्टलवर करता येतो.

3. **नमो शेतकरी महासन्मान निधी (NSMNY)**  
   - ही केंद्र सरकारची योजना असून, पीएमकिसान योजनेअंतर्गत पात्र शेतकऱ्यांना अतिरिक्त वार्षिक **₹6,000** लाभ मिळतो.  
   - यासाठी स्वतंत्र अर्ज करायला लागत नाही, फक्त पीएमकिसान लाभार्थी असणे आवश्यक आहे.

आपण या योजनांचा लाभ घेण्यासाठी महाडीबीटी (mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in) पोर्टलवर जाऊन ऑनलाईन अर्ज करू शकता.

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

आपण यापैकी कोणत्याही योजनेविषयी अधिक माहिती हवी असल्यास किंवा अर्ज प्रक्रियेबाबत मार्गदर्शन हवे असल्यास कृपया विचारावे.
